system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

Your facial features are replaced or augmented with memory materials you can sculpt and reshape, essentially granting you the innate benefits of having a disguise kit for Communication (Disguise) tests. It takes some time, a minute or more, to do the necessary reshaping for a disguise, although your features can “snap back” to a default state with just an Activate action, the same as “ripping off” a disguise. In some cases, the GM may grant you a bonus on your Communication (Disguise) tests, but otherwise this augmentation just eliminates the need for makeup and prosthetics to change your appearance.
